section_order: Hero with headline and CTA > Logo bar > Features grid > Testimonials > Pricing > Final CTA
cta_placement: Above fold primary + after social proof secondary
color_strategy: Primary on hero CTA / neutral background / accent on feature icons
effects: Hero parallax + feature cards hover lift + scroll-triggered animations
conversion_tips: Include one clear CTA above fold and repeat after social proof

section_order: Hero with problem > Before state > After state > How it works > Results > CTA
color_strategy: Dark/muted for before state / bright/vibrant for after state
effects: Split screen reveal + counter animations + before/after slider
conversion_tips: Show concrete metrics and visual proof of transformation

section_order: Hero > Logo bar > Case studies > Testimonials wall > Stats > CTA
cta_placement: After testimonial section when trust is highest
color_strategy: Neutral background to let testimonials stand out / accent on stats
effects: Testimonial carousel + stat counter animations + logo fade in
conversion_tips: Lead with recognizable logos and quantified results

section_order: Hero with embedded demo > Key features > How it works > Pricing > CTA
color_strategy: Subtle background to focus on product / accent on interactive elements
effects: Interactive product demo + tooltip highlights + smooth transitions
conversion_tips: Let users experience the product before asking them to sign up

section_order: Hook headline > Problem > Journey > Solution > Results > CTA
cta_placement: At emotional peak after the story resolves
color_strategy: Evolving palette from problem (muted) to solution (vibrant)
effects: Scroll-triggered reveals + progressive disclosure + parallax text
conversion_tips: Build emotional connection before presenting the solution

section_order: Hero > Quick value prop > Pricing table > Feature comparison > FAQ > CTA
cta_placement: Pricing visible early / toggle annual vs monthly
color_strategy: Highlight recommended plan with accent color / muted for others
effects: Pricing toggle animation + plan hover highlight + FAQ accordion
conversion_tips: Anchor with highest plan first then show recommended mid-tier

section_order: Full-screen hero > Scrolling feature sections > Single CTA
cta_placement: One CTA at the end after full context
color_strategy: Monochrome with single accent / generous whitespace
effects: Full-page scroll snap + fade-in sections + minimal transitions
conversion_tips: Remove all distractions and focus on one conversion goal

section_order: Hero with autoplay video > Key message > Features > CTA
color_strategy: Dark overlay on video / bright CTA contrast
effects: Autoplay muted video + scroll-triggered play + overlay text
conversion_tips: Keep video under 60 seconds and add captions for muted autoplay

section_order: Hero positioning against competitors > Feature comparison > Pricing > Switch CTA
color_strategy: Green for your features / red/muted for competitor gaps
effects: Comparison table animations + checkmark reveals + switch CTA
conversion_tips: Be honest in comparisons and highlight unique differentiators

section_order: Hero > User stats > Community showcase > Getting started > CTA
color_strategy: Warm inclusive palette / user-generated content highlights
effects: User avatars animation + activity feed + community counter
conversion_tips: Show real community activity and make joining feel easy

section_order: Hero with ROI calculator > Results > How it works > Testimonials > CTA
color_strategy: Accent on calculator results / neutral on form inputs
effects: Interactive calculator + real-time results + chart animations
conversion_tips: Pre-fill calculator with realistic defaults that show value

section_order: Hero > Deep-dive feature 1 > Feature 2 > Feature 3 > Integration > CTA
cta_placement: After each feature section as micro-CTAs
color_strategy: Alternate background colors per section for visual rhythm
effects: Feature demo animations + screenshot transitions + code snippets
conversion_tips: Focus on 3 core features max and go deep on each

section_order: Hero with countdown > Sneak peek > Early access benefits > Email capture
cta_placement: Single email capture as primary CTA
color_strategy: Exclusive feel with dark background / accent on countdown
effects: Countdown timer + email success animation + sneak peek reveals
conversion_tips: Create urgency with countdown and exclusive early access perks

section_order: Hero > Trust logos > Solutions by role > Case studies > Security > Contact
color_strategy: Conservative trustworthy palette / minimal accent usage
effects: Subtle professional animations + case study carousels
conversion_tips: Address security and compliance concerns before the CTA

section_order: Hero with trial CTA > Quick setup steps > Feature highlights > FAQ > Trial CTA
cta_placement: Prominent trial CTA top and bottom / no credit card messaging
color_strategy: Green for trial CTA / trust indicators near form
effects: Trial form inline + step counter + benefit tooltips
conversion_tips: Emphasize no credit card required and quick setup time
